qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global leader in water, waste, and energy services with over 70% of revenue protected by long-term municipal concessions (10-30 years) and industrial contracts containing contractual inflation indexation formulas (CPI/labor/energy). High switching barriers in specialized hazardous waste treatment and municipal water treatment plants. Successfully integrated Suez, expanding GAAP ROIC from 7.37% in 2022 to 12.07% in 2025 as cumulative post-merger synergies exceeded €500M.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Peace-of-Mind Balance Sheet & Leverage, REJECT). Global ecological services champion with defensible water and waste concessions and contractual inflation indexation. However, capital-intensive utility structure carries €16.5B in long-term debt and €9.1B in net debt against €1.2B in TTM net income (Net Debt / NI = 7.5x, well above the 4.0x ceiling), with interest coverage of only 3.65x failing the > 5.0x cycle threshold (consistent with sub-industry g6_default=N).
qualitative.evidence: FY2025 revenue reached €44.4B with EBITDA of €6.8B and EBIT of €3.2B. Post-Suez integration drove GAAP ROIC up to 12.07% in FY25 (4-year median 10.25%, ROCE after-tax 9.4%). While Owner FCF conversion is robust (>100% of NI), balance sheet leverage remains structurally elevated post-Suez with long-term debt of €16,541M and net debt of €9,101M against net income of €1,217M (debt repayment time > 7 years). FY25 interest expense of €876M yields EBIT interest coverage of 3.65x, violating the Gate 6 fortress baseline (> 5.0x).

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
